title: slopbuckets config
description: Configuration for buckets.config.json, read by the slopbuckets CLI.

$schema.description: URL of this JSON Schema, for editor autocomplete.

adapter.description: Language adapter the CLI uses to read the project.

root.description: Folder of the root bucket, relative to the project. It cannot hold { } < > * ` , or |, because access and layout lines start with it and read those characters as glob syntax.

alias.description: Import prefix for every internal import.

scripts.description: Node scripts by name, each a path relative to the folder of buckets.config.json. Access and layout lines name a script in backticks, and the values it prints, one bucket name per line, join the group that names it. Each check runs each script once, as node <file> in the project folder, with a 10 second timeout. The lock stores the output, so other values are a config-changed difference.

additionalProperties.description: Path of a Node script relative to the folder of buckets.config.json, such as "tools/repos.mjs".

access.description: Which buckets may use code that originates in which other buckets. Without it, nothing is checked.

default.description: Outcome for an import that no deny or allow line matches. When several lines match, the most specific one decides.

allow.description: Lines "A -> B": code in bucket A may use code that originates in bucket B. Under "default": "allow", an allow line opens an exception inside a deny line.

deny.description: Lines "A -> B": code in bucket A may not use code that originates in bucket B.

layout.description: Which bucket folders may exist. A bucket also passes when no deny line matches it and an allow line can match a bucket below it, so its ancestors may exist. Without it, any bucket folder may exist.

default.description: Outcome for a bucket folder that no deny or allow line matches. When several lines match, the most specific one decides.

allow.description: Globs of the bucket folders that may exist.

deny.description: Globs of the bucket folders that may not exist.

items.description: A line is two globs over bucket paths joined by "->", such as "root/api/** -> root/log". Each side starts with the root path or with "**". "**" matches zero or more buckets and "*" any characters inside a name. A group matches one of its values, separated by commas, never by "|". Within one name, "{a,b}" groups match any values, "{{a,b}}" groups match values that never decrease, "<a,b>" groups match values that differ from each other, and "<<a,b>>" groups match values that strictly increase, from left to right and by character code. One name may use only one of "{{...}}", "<...>" and "<<...>>", which list exact values without "*". A script name of "scripts" between two backticks stands for the values that script prints. Inside a group it is one value between commas, and alone in a name it is a group of its own.

A line is one glob over bucket paths, such as "root/*/*". It starts with the root path or with "**". "**" matches zero or more buckets and "*" any characters inside a name. A group matches one of its values, separated by commas, never by "|". Within one name, "{a,b}" groups match any values, "{{a,b}}" groups match values that never decrease, "<a,b>" groups match values that differ from each other, and "<<a,b>>" groups match values that strictly increase, from left to right and by character code. One name may use only one of "{{...}}", "<...>" and "<<...>>", which list exact values without "*". A script name of "scripts" between two backticks stands for the values that script prints. Inside a group it is one value between commas, and alone in a name it is a group of its own.
